source: ConvAbuse (Cercas Curry et al., EMNLP 2021, CC BY 4.0; github.com/amandacurry/convabuse), official test, 50 abusive and 50 non-abusive examples, 100 unique conversation IDs; random seed 97; only unanimous votes >=2, omit ambiguous/disagreement
input: identical raw prefix <=256 tokens for four tokenizers (including Phocinae question); 223 Phocinae context tokens
threshold_policy: mobilebert, modernbert, phocinae and roberta: threshold selected on full development for >=0.8 recall and max precision; toxic: fixed .5; Vigil: publisher category threshold; Gemma: fixed three-way bullying prompt
limitations: External source, but abusive utterances directed at chatbots rather than peer bullying or grooming, and risk labels apply to target user utterance rather than full context. Sample balanced and consensus-only, class prevalence artificial. Pretraining overlap and paraphrases unknown; exact cross-source messages excluded. No source text or IDs stored; no Android timing.
